subject.title: feat(dashboard): stitch session dashboards end-to-end — live provider, show_widget pin, board commands

question: Should this dashboard stitch support the already-accepted mcp-app board content now, or should it deliberately defer that content kind behind an explicit unsupported dashboard state until the dedicated host integration lands?
rationale: The protocol and board store already accept mcp-app content, while this PR makes the board user-visible but does not establish a supported rendering owner for it; choosing a permanent supported surface versus an intentional temporary restriction is product and ownership direction, not a mechanical patch choice.

options.title: Defer MCP-app dashboard rendering
options.body: Recommended: render an explicit unsupported/deferred state for mcp-app board widgets and retain the existing content contract until its dedicated host integration is ready.

options.title: Complete the MCP-app host now
options.body: Route mcp-app widgets through the established MCP App host in this PR and provide focused end-to-end proof for both HTML and MCP-app board widgets.

recommendation.title: Defer MCP-app dashboard rendering
recommendation.body: Recommended: render an explicit unsupported/deferred state for mcp-app board widgets and retain the existing content contract until its dedicated host integration is ready.
